title: Scaling Laws for Vision-Language Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2611.22351v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as central foundation models combining multimodal perception with text comprehension. While VLMs are traditionally built via late fusion by continued pre-training an off-the-shelf language model on multimodal (image-text) data, mixing modalities from the start of pre-training (early fusion) has recently gained traction. However, the fundamental trade-offs between these paradigms remain poorly understood, resulting in expensive and heuristic-driven training recipes. In this paper, we systematically analyze the learning dynamics of these multimodal pre-training processes, showing that validation losses during vision-language fusion can be modeled by separating the base learning trajectory, where different data types contribute at distinct rates, from a distribution shift driven by the competition between modalities. translated_title: 视觉-语言融合的缩放定律
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）已成为将多模态感知与文本理解相结合的核心基础模型。传统上，VLM通过后期融合（late fusion）方式构建，即在现成的语言模型上继续使用多模态（图文）数据进行预训练；而从头开始预训练时就混合多种模态（早期融合，early fusion）的做法近来也日益受到关注。然而，这两种范式之间的根本权衡仍鲜为人知，导致训练方案成本高昂且依赖启发式经验。本文系统地分析了这些多模态预训练过程的学习动态，表明视觉-语言融合过程中的验证损失可以通过将基础学习轨迹（其中不同数据类型以不同速率做出贡献）与由模态间竞争驱动的分布偏移相分离来建模。我们推导出一个统一描述这些动态的缩放定律，从而能够准确……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过系统分析多模态预训练的学习动态，推导出一个统一的缩放定律，将基础学习轨迹与模态竞争驱动的分布偏移相分离，从而为理解视觉-语言融合中早期融合与后期融合范式的根本权衡提供了原理性依据。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a unified scaling law that separates the base learning trajectory from modality-competition-driven distribution shifts, providing a principled understanding of the fundamental trade-offs between early and late fusion paradigms in vision-language pre-training.
